shortDescription: MSI GeForce RTX 5070 12G SHADOW 3X OC Graphics Card (12GB GDDR7 VRAM / NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture / SHADOW 3X Triple Fan Thermal Design / Factory Overclocked / PCIe Gen 5 Support / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warrant
descriptionHtml:
MSI GeForce RTX 5070 12G SHADOW 3X OC Graphics Card (12GB GDDR7 VRAM / NVIDIA Blackwell Architecture / SHADOW 3X Triple Fan Thermal Design / Factory Overclocked / PCIe Gen 5 Support / 3 Years Official Local Agent Warranty)

Elevate your gaming and content creation performance with the MSI GeForce RTX 5070 12G SHADOW 3X OC graphics card, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with an Official 3-Year Local Agent Warranty. Built on the groundbreaking NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and powered by ultra-fast 12GB GDDR7 memory, this GPU delivers extraordinary frame rates, next-generation ray tracing, and AI-accelerated graphics. Equipped with the advanced SHADOW 3X cooling system, featuring three high-efficiency fans and a reinforced metal backplate, it maintains optimal thermal performance and quiet operation during intense high-resolution gaming sessions.
